errors.text_span: (вероятно индексирани към базова стойност от 100 през 1990 г.)
errors.evidence: The description speculates that the Y-axis values are indexed to a base value of 100 in 1990. While plausible because the first data point is 100, this is an interpretation not explicitly stated in the figure.

The description incorrectly claims that the gray line ('EU-27 Прогноза на база добавени политики') slightly increases until 2022. The figure clearly shows this line decreasing continuously from its starting point.
